items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: And I don't want to make it too long but I'll tell you some of the members of the band... He had Darius Ballera.

ctx.x: Now we formed a band ourselves.

And I don't want to make it too long but I'll tell you some of the members of the band. On drumming we had Si Frasier, Josiah Frasier on drumming. On bass we had Eddie Barrera. On piano we had Mercedes Fields. On the trumpet we had Bush Hall. Well Bush Hall died and he was replaced with Red Alam. He had Red Alam. He had Darius Ballera. He had Darius Ballera.
